arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK031. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. Right-facing upright head at thin waterline, lower jaw raised and mouth partly closed. Pink tongue projects from the mouth then curls UPWARD over the front/upper lip at the RIGHT side, forming the broad original curled tongue shape. Keep one wide eye with visible pupil and exact snout angle. No full body/tail. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
